proposed: لَهُ غَيْرَ مَا هَا فِيهِ فَاحْضُرْ مُكَمَّلَا
evidence: PDF p.59 (printed 57, content-review/_ref/pages/p059.png), v.315b prints «لَهُ غَيْرَ مَا هَا فِيهِ فَاحْضُرْ مُكَمَّلَا» with a clear inter-word space between black «مَا» and green «هَا»; Al-Wafi (content-review/pack/D/c04.md, printed p.148) also prints «له غير ما ها فيه فاحضر مكمّلا» and glosses «(غير ما ها)».
reasoning: A missing space fused the relative pronoun «مَا» (black) and the Qur'anic feminine pronoun «هَا» (green) into «مَاهَا». Restoring the space matches the PDF and keeps the two distinct words and grammatical structure clear for students.
